title: #19188 split: 7 `view` keys carry no liveness verdict anywhere, and five of them are one question — authored, or per-user state?
body:
## The seven

#19188's census could bucket 267 of 274 keys. These **7** it could not, and all 7 are `view` keys with **no liveness verdict at any coordinate** (direct or container-child) and no description marker that settles author-versus-platform:

| key | its own description, verbatim | the question |
|---|---|---|
| `view.config` | 「List-family view configuration」 | a REQUIRED (non-optional) object carrying no verdict anywhere |
| `view.viewKind` | (none) | the union discriminator literal; probably machine/derived, but nothing on this tree says so |
| `view.scope` | 「Identity layer (defaults to package for source-loaded views)」 | authored, or set by the loader? |
| `view.owner` | 「Owner user id — set when scope is personal」 | platform-set on a personal view, or authorable? |
| `view.isDefault` | 「the object's default view in the switcher」 | author intent, or per-user state? |
| `view.hidden` | 「Hidden from the switcher (per-user / per-org declutter)」 | same question |
| `view.order` | 「Sort order within the object's view switcher」 | same question — and its sibling `sortOrder` IS marked not-authored while this one is not |

## ⭐ Five of them are one question

`scope` · `owner` · `isDefault` · `hidden` · `order` are a single coherent question: **which of the switcher/identity keys are authored, and which are per-user state?** The census round called this 「the one thing in this census nobody on this tree can answer by measurement」.

⚠️ But measurement can narrow it before anyone rules. Their siblings `columnState`, `isPinned` and `sortOrder` already say 「written by the console, not authored」 in their own `describe()` text, so the console is very likely the writer for some of these five. ⇒ the census round recommended **measure the objectui writers first, then rule** — cheaper than ruling, and it produces the evidence a ruling needs. ⛔ This seat adopts that as a recommendation on the card, not as a decision.

## Dedup words

`view switcher identity keys authored` · `view.scope owner isDefault hidden order` · `per-user view state vs authored` · `no liveness verdict view keys` · `viewKind discriminator authorability`
